description: This Java source file defines the ResourceBundleMapWrapper class, which allows a ResourceBundle to be used as a Map with additional stack-based layering support. It includes inner class InternalRbmWrapper for resource bundle handling.

classes.name: ResourceBundleMapWrapper
classes.description: A Map wrapper around ResourceBundle with stack layering support, allowing layered resource lookups and optional string expansion with context.

classes.name: InternalRbmWrapper
classes.description: Inner class that wraps a ResourceBundle and provides Map interface for its keys and values, with lazy map creation.

methods.name: ResourceBundleMapWrapper
methods.description: Constructors for initializing the wrapper with a ResourceBundle or InternalRbmWrapper, with optional context.

methods.name: addBottomResourceBundle
methods.description: Adds a ResourceBundle or InternalRbmWrapper to the bottom of the stack.

methods.name: pushResourceBundle
methods.description: Pushes a ResourceBundle onto the top of the stack, overriding lower layers.

methods.name: getInitialResourceBundle
methods.description: Returns the initial ResourceBundle used for the wrapper.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the stack, with optional string expansion if context is provided.
